# NOAA Office for Coastal Management

> Federal agency delivering coastal management programs, research reserves, resilience funding, and digital tools to protect and restore America's coasts.

The NOAA Office for Coastal Management administers the National Coastal Zone Management Program, operates the National Estuarine Research Reserve System, and provides funding for coastal resilience projects through initiatives like the National Coastal Resilience Fund and Bipartisan Infrastructure Law grants. The office serves all U.S. coastal states and territories through partnerships, fellowships, and data-driven decision support tools.

## Key Topics

- Coastal Zone Management
- National Estuarine Research Reserve System
- Coastal Resilience

- Bipartisan Infrastructure Law

## Core Programs

- [NOAA Office for Coastal Management](https://coast.noaa.gov): Homepage with core programs and initiatives
- [The National Coastal Zone Management Program](https://coast.noaa.gov/czm): Federal coastal zone management program providing protection and sustainable development guidance
- [National Estuarine Research Reserve System](https://coast.noaa.gov/nerrs): Network of 30 coastal research sites for estuarine ecosystem study and monitoring
- [Our Office](https://coast.noaa.gov/about): Mission statement and organizational overview of the Office for Coastal Management

## Funding & Grants

- [Funding Opportunities](https://coast.noaa.gov/funding): Central hub for all funding opportunities and grant programs for coastal management projects
- [Bipartisan Infrastructure Law Awards](https://coast.noaa.gov/funding/bil): Coastal resilience funding and grant awards under the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law
- [National Coastal Resilience Fund](https://coast.noaa.gov/funding/bil/ncrf/overview.html): Grants for habitat restoration and coastal infrastructure resilience projects
- [NOAA Climate Resilience Regional Challenge](https://coast.noaa.gov/funding/resilience-challenge): Competitive grant funding program supporting regional climate resilience initiatives

## Data, Tools & Training

- [Digital Coast Home](https://coast.noaa.gov/digitalcoast): Portal providing coastal data, decision-support tools, and training resources for professionals
- [Coastal Management Fellowship](https://coast.noaa.gov/fellowship/coastalmanagement.html): Postgraduate training program for emerging coastal management professionals
- [Digital Coast Fellowship](https://coast.noaa.gov/fellowship/digitalcoast.html): Postgraduate fellowship in coastal data tools and digital decision support
- [NOAA Coastal Resilience Fellowship Program](https://coast.noaa.gov/funding/resilience-challenge/fellowship.html): Early-career professional development program in coastal resilience and adaptation

## State & Regional Resources

- [States](https://coast.noaa.gov/states): Directory of coastal states and territories with regional information and partnerships
- [Impact Stories](https://coast.noaa.gov/states/stories): Case studies showcasing successful coastal restoration and resilience projects across regions
- [Fast Facts](https://coast.noaa.gov/coastal-facts): Reference hub with coastal statistics, environmental data, and key metrics

## Organization & Support

- [Organization](https://coast.noaa.gov/about/organization): Organizational structure and management hierarchy
- [Employment](https://coast.noaa.gov/about/employment): Job opportunities and career positions at NOAA Office for Coastal Management
- [Directions](https://coast.noaa.gov/about/directions): Office locations and directions for Charleston and Silver Spring facilities
